headline: Profits climb as revenue and equity both build
summary_short: Raymond James reported Q2 FY2026 revenue of $4.36B (+2.3% q/q, +13.5% y/y) and net income of $595M (+36.5% y/y); diluted EPS was $3.01, up from $2.12 a year ago.
summary_long: Revenue was $4.36B, up 2.3% q/q and up 13.5% y/y. Net income was $595M, up 9.4% q/q and up 36.5% y/y. Diluted EPS was $3.01, up 10.7% q/q and up 42.0% y/y from $2.12. Total cash was $9.98B, down 11.1% q/q but up 8.5% y/y. Shareholders' equity was $12.70B, up 1.1% q/q and up 3.6% y/y. No drivers or guidance are assessed in this KPI-only summary.
